rationale: Damage to the policyholder's own home structure (flooring, drywall, contents) caused by failure of the policyholder's own plumbing system is textbook property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder discovered extensive basement flooding caused by a burst water supply line in their own plumbing system upon returning from a work trip. Damage includes approximately 2 inches of water across the entire basement, buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall (up to 1 foot), and ruined stored boxes. This is a high-severity property damage claim requiring prompt on-site assessment, mitigation, and coordinated restoration work.

case_facts.incident_type: basement flooding with water damage to flooring, drywall, and stored items
case_facts.damaged_items: hardwood flooring (buckled), drywall (soaked up to 1 foot), stored boxes (ruined)
case_facts.cause: burst water supply line in policyholder's plumbing system

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) with no third-party involvement or injury.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; approximately four shingles blown off. Estimated repair cost $400 with no water intrusion or secondary damage. Deductible is $2,500, so policyholder should understand this claim does not meet the threshold for coverage payout.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off roof overhang
